sources.title: LAC Title 48 Part I, §9775, Transfer and/or Discharge of the Resident (excerpt from the Department of Health's published nursing facility standards)
sources.source_date: Louisiana Administrative Code February 2022; §9775 historical note LR 42:1911 (November 2016)
sources.notes: The 2026-08-30 capture took this excerpt by hand, cutting within pages 27 and 28 to §9775 alone. This recipe takes both printed pages whole instead, which is reproducible where a hand cut is not: the captured text is a superset of the standing one, adding the neighbouring sections that share those pages. The Administrative Code prints in two columns and pdftotext -layout renders each printed line as the left column followed by the right, so a subsection running down one column is broken across lines carrying unrelated text from its neighbour; the running heads, page numbers and the start of §9777 inside this range are the document's own and are preserved. Page numbers rather than a text slice because the range is what a reader can check against the published PDF.

sources.title: Louisiana Governor's Office of Elderly Affairs — Louisiana Ombudsman Program
sources.notes: Scope is the whole body, matching the 2026-08-30 capture, which kept the surrounding chrome: the office's navigation appears twice in the served page and the regional ombudsman roster is included as served. This page carries the state's ombudsman contacts behind Cloudflare email obfuscation; the 2026-08-30 capture recorded eight placeholders where addresses are published, and decode_cfemail in the shared capture reader resolves them (FA-Q-20260902-01, FA-Q-20260904-04).

sources.title: Louisiana Division of Administrative Law — Areas of Law: Health
sources.notes: Added 2026-09-15, deepening the state to a full page: the Division's own statement of the address, phone and fax the rule (LAC 48:I.9775.E) requires the facility's notice to carry, closing the gap the baseline page's hearing-office row and change log finding (1) recorded. The page states its 'Medicaid Recipient/Applicant Fair Hearings' route (form or mail to the HH Section post office box, fax number, typically-30-day filing window) for actions terminating, suspending, or reducing 'Medicaid eligibility or covered services'; it does not separately name a nursing facility involuntary transfer/discharge appeal under §9775.E, so this page quotes the general route and states that the page does not confirm it governs a §9775.E appeal specifically — see the change log. Plain curl with a browser user-agent returns the whole document; scope 'body' carries the site's own navigation as served.

slice.from: II. Leave Days for Residents of Nursing Facilities

sources.notes: Added 2026-09-15, deepening the state to a full page. The slice covers only section II (nursing facility leave/bed-hold days), stopping at the page footer that closes it; section I (ICF/IID) precedes it and is out of scope, and the pages after this excerpt (evacuation-related bed-hold provisions, further back in the same attachment) are a poor scan with visible OCR corruption in the served PDF -- letters dropped, ligatures fused ('ofabsence', 'retum'), diacritics inserted into plain English words -- and are not captured as quotable text for that reason; the ordinary hospital/home leave-day policy this page needs sits entirely in the clean section captured here. 'TN: 24-0008 Approval Date: May 29, 2024' is the transmittal footer text and appears twice in the document with different internal spacing (once after section I, once after section II, whitespace-normalized alike); the slice's 'to' anchor matches the first occurrence after 'from', which is section II's own footer, by construction of the search order rather than an explicit occurrence key.
